title: Validate and publish priority join routes
objective: At least fifteen intended joins have inspectable compatibility evidence.
outcome: Join validation fixtures record input counts, eligible key counts, uniqueness, nulls, mapping multiplicity and expected outputs, including one valid and one incompatible temporal/universe case. Fixtures detect row multiplication, leading-zero loss and unmatched rows rather than just successful SQL execution. Scoped linkage metrics separate sampled checks from full-release checks. No route reports a universal match rate from a tiny sample. Incompatible contexts remain blocked. Machine/UI consumers receive identical compatibility and limits. HCRIS-to-NPPES cannot claim CCN=NPI. R08 remains incomplete if fewer than fifteen routes are qualified. Sealed packages/identity/src/join-routes.mjs is not edited.

commits.subject: Build join validation fixtures
commits.instructions: For each selected route, record input counts, eligible key counts, uniqueness, nulls, mapping multiplicity and expected outputs. Include one valid and one incompatible temporal/universe case.
commits.verification: Fixtures detect row multiplication, leading-zero loss and unmatched rows rather than just successful SQL execution.

commits.subject: Compute scoped linkage metrics
commits.instructions: Report matched/unmatched denominators, join expansion and exclusion reasons. Separate sampled checks from full-release checks and preserve evidence hashes.
commits.verification: No route reports a universal match rate from a tiny sample; incompatible contexts remain blocked.

commits.subject: Publish qualified routes and caveats
commits.instructions: Promote reviewed route metadata through the same generation and expose direct/two-hop paths only where supported. Recheck all fifteen priority routes.
commits.verification: Machine/UI consumers receive identical compatibility and limits; HCRIS-to-NPPES cannot claim CCN=NPI.
